Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like your focus on customers with volume makes continuity especially important to this renewal. We value the relationship and want a straightforward agreement that supports your planning. What pricing could a longer commitment support, and could you share your cost-breakdown XLSX so we can work through the underlying elements together?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our recent orders for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 were at 4.29, 4.39 per 1 (po:4500014329-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014467-10). Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.79 per unit, 14 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Likewise, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. While we acknowledge your calculations and past order history, our pricing must reflect current operational realities and market conditions. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that our detailed cost breakdowns are strictly confidential and cannot be shared. 

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and 14-day payment terms, which enables us to offer a revised price of €4.87 per unit. Consequently, our offer is a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. That supports a price of about EUR 4.41.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.80 per unit, 14 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

You welcomed the longer agreement while drawing a clear boundary on further cost-based reductions; it sounds like commercial certainty matters most now. We are ready to conclude the renewal and share the requested calculation for transparency, not to reopen the price discussion. What remains for us to finalise the agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.86 per unit, 14 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We are pleased to accept your proposal of €4.86 per unit with 14-day payment terms and a 36-month contract. This represents our best possible price for these terms, and we thank you for providing the call-off schedule to finalize the agreement. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership. 

To confirm, our Angebot is a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
